articles.title: New Old Crocodile Is Missing Its Nose Tip, Just Like the Sphinx
articles.summary: Scientists named a new extinct crocodile from Egypt. Like the Great Sphinx, its fossil is missing the tip of its nose.

articles.title: Scientists See Tiny Particles Make Ripples in a Super-Hot 'Soup'
articles.summary: Physicists found that the super-hot matter from the start of the universe flows like a liquid, with particles leaving ripples behind.

articles.title: Rosalind Franklin Knew Her Famous DNA Photo Was Special, Study Says
articles.summary: A new study of Rosalind Franklin's notes says she knew her DNA photos showed a helix shape before others built the famous model.
